response.justification: The candidate is a strong, versatile senior engineer with deep full-stack (TypeScript/Node.js) and notable systems-level experience in DLang, but the role demands hands-on modern C++ expertise, industrial IoT protocols, and IEC 62443 secure-development experience. His only substantive C++ work was a brief stint at National Instruments in 2014–2015, and there is no evidence of MQTT, message brokers at industrial scale, OT/industrial cybersecurity, or automation-domain background. The gap in the core competency (C++) and the domain mismatch outweigh his general seniority.
strengths: 15+ years of software development with clear senior/staff-level progression
Low-latency, high-throughput systems experience (async I/O, fibers, caching at Sociomantic)
Strong engineering practices: TDD, CI/CD, testing tooling, mentoring and teaching
concerns: Minimal recent C++ experience (last professional C++ work ~2015)
No IEC 62443, SDL, or industrial cybersecurity exposure
No MQTT, industrial protocols (Modbus, OPC UA), or automation/OT domain background
